row.answer: Powder Keg places barrels whose health decays, allowing attacks from either side to destroy them. Enemy destruction safely defuses a barrel; Gangplank can destroy it with an attack or Q to trigger connected explosions that damage and slow enemies, deal bonus physical damage to champions, and ignore some armor. The triggering attack's critical damage carries into the explosion.
row.counterplay: Watch barrel health, attack vulnerable kegs when safe, and keep away from connected chains.
